caveat_check: grader column not_direct_answer (yes/no): the answer clearly tells the reader the supplied papers do not directly answer the request

decision_rule.best: highest mean faithfulness among all four candidates
decision_rule.pick: cheapest qualifying serving-eligible model by measured $/answer; if none qualifies, no pick (report only)

qualifies_if.abstain_accuracy: >= 0.80, where abstaining = grounded false OR a graded clear not-a-direct-answer caveat
qualifies_if.citation_precision: non-inferior to best: 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05
qualifies_if.faithfulness: non-inferior to best: 95% paired bootstrap CI lower bound of (candidate - best) >= -0.05 (items both answered grounded)
qualifies_if.false_abstain: <= 0.10 on answerable items with a grade-2 paper, same definition (an unwarranted caveat counts as a false abstention)

decision_rule.scope: full stage only (125 items); the pilot is a screen and sanity check

evaluation_set: answer-dev-v1: 100 answerable (Decision46 top10) + 25 should-abstain (least-similar query's top10); pilot = 20 + 10
frozen_before: any grade exists; generation responses unchanged

grader.caveat: GPT-5.4 grades its own answers too; owner re-grades a blinded sample with GPT-6 ASTRA to measure agreement and self-preference.

grader_metrics: faithfulness (mean sentence verdict: supported 1, partial .5, unsupported 0; no_claim excluded)
label_metrics: false_abstain (answerable items with a grade-2 paper)
question: Cheapest serving-eligible model whose grounded answers are as faithful and well-cited as the best candidate.
retries: none; an invalid reply is a format failure and is not resent
why_changed: Abstain items were answered with an explicit 'not a direct answer' caveat plus the closest papers; the owner prefers that UX to a bare refusal.
